description: A single-channel touch controller: dragging the pad sets a level, and the output slides to that level at a rate you choose

params.text: Drag to set the level, 0V at the bottom and 10V at the top, which the output then slides to at the rate set by RATE
An attenuverter setting the range of the CV output: at full right the pad gives 0-10V, at full left 0 to -10V
Transition time of the CV, from 0 for an instant jump to 4 seconds per volt; turning it during a transition changes the rate of the transition under way
In the top position a slide is exponential, in the bottom position linear

outputs.text: The control voltage set by the pad, after the ATTV knob

menu: Rate knob x3 (max 12 s/V) — stretches the rate knob to 12 seconds per volt, so a full 0 to 10V transition takes 2 minutes instead of 40 seconds
Auto-return — sends the level back to a chosen percentage of the pad's range when the mouse button is released; Off (default) leaves the level where it was put
